d:
Keep moving, building strength, and feeling capable without putting weight through your wrists, elbows, or shoulders. This 30 minute practice shifts the challenge into your legs, balance, core, and mobility, making it especially useful when your upper body needs time away from your usual training.
An injury can change how you practice without taking movement away completely. Work within the guidance of your healthcare professional, respect your current limits, and use this time to discover what your body can still do.
